question: What does the SvelteKit adapter-static package do?
response_text: `@sveltejs/adapter-static` prerenders a SvelteKit app into plain static HTML/CSS/JS files, so it can be served by any static file host or reverse proxy without a Node.js runtime — a common choice when a separate backend already serves the app's API.
